zh.name: 3A 架构候选分析契约
zh.description: 基于已发布源 Baseline 和当前设计水位创建精确 Scope、带证据的 3A 候选集；不会直接发布权威架构。
zh.authType: 精确应用服务 knowledge:write 和 governance:run 授权
zh.idempotency: 相同 Scope 和幂等键返回同一个不可变候选批次，或返回明确的摘要冲突。
zh.rateLimit: 仅允许受治理的候选分析提交。
zh.timeout: 请求边界 10 秒；源数据读取有界且持久化使用事务。
zh.compatibilityPolicy: 候选 DTO 只允许兼容扩展；不兼容的候选语义必须创建新版本契约。

asset.name: 3A Architecture Candidate Set
asset.description: Stores an exact-Scope candidate snapshot, candidate architecture revisions, exclusions, blocking issues, waterlines, and immutable analysis evidence before review and promotion.
relationships: One Candidate Set belongs to one exact Scope.
One Candidate Set references one published source Baseline.
One Candidate Set owns candidate architecture revisions until promotion.
A stale source waterline invalidates a READY Candidate Set.
constraints: All uniqueness and reads include exact application-service Scope.
Candidate revisions are not authoritative until review, promotion, reconciliation, and publication.
Candidate content is idempotent and snapshot-bound.
asset.lifecycle: GENERATING, READY, BLOCKED, STALE, APPROVED, REJECTED, PROMOTED
asset.lineage: MCP analyze_3a_architecture_candidates, published Baseline, projection manifest, design catalog, typed relationships, and Design Change Session

asset.name: 3A Candidate Cross-Layer Closure Rule
asset.description: A candidate architecture is reviewable only when every SYS unit realizes a BIZ unit, every TECH unit is used by a SYS unit, and every primary asset selector resolves to at most one unit.
asset.condition: An authorized Agent submits a 3A Candidate Set for analysis or review.
asset.action: Validate exact Scope, evidence, layer ceilings, primary membership uniqueness, BIZ-to-SYS realization, and SYS-to-TECH dependency before marking the Candidate Set READY.
asset.exception: Missing, ambiguous, stale, cross-Scope, or orphaned facts block the Candidate Set without publishing partial architecture.
examples: A SYS unit without a BIZ realization is rejected.
Two candidate units claiming the same primary asset are rejected.
A changed catalog digest makes a READY Candidate Set stale.

zh.name: 3A 候选跨层闭包规则
zh.description: 只有每个 SYS 单元都实现某个 BIZ 单元、每个 TECH 单元都被 SYS 使用且每个主资产选择器最多解析到一个单元时，候选架构才可审核。
zh.condition: 授权 Agent 提交 3A 候选集进行分析或审核。
zh.action: 在候选集标记为 READY 前校验精确 Scope、证据、分层上限、主成员唯一性、BIZ 到 SYS 的实现关系以及 SYS 到 TECH 的依赖关系。
zh.exception: 缺失、歧义、过期、跨 Scope 或孤立事实会阻塞候选集，不发布部分架构。
examples: 没有 BIZ 实现关系的 SYS 单元会被拒绝。
两个候选单元声明同一主资产会被拒绝。
目录摘要变化会使 READY 候选集过期。

proposalNonGoal.en: Continuous legacy scanning, connector delivery, cross-Scope aggregation, and external APPLY remain deferred federation increments. The concrete v7 Candidate Set publication is also deferred until an authorized Agent supplies an evidence-bound candidate that passes review, promotion, reconciliation, and projection read-back.
proposalNonGoal.zh: 持续存量扫描、连接器交付、跨 Scope 聚合和外部 APPLY 仍属于延期的联邦增量。具体 v7 候选集发布也要等获授权 Agent 提供带证据的候选集，并通过审核、晋升、对账和投影回读后再进行。

decisions.status: Governance core implemented; concrete v7 Candidate Set publication deferred
decisions.reason: No evidence-bound concrete v7 Candidate Set is currently approved for publication; publishing one would fabricate architectural intent while v6 remains the last known-good Baseline.
decisions.retryTrigger: When an authorized Agent supplies an evidence-bound Candidate Set against the current published Baseline and review, promotion, reconciliation, and projection read-back all pass.
